summary: The current manifest binds the support agent directly to the existing SupportAssistant and loadSupportInstruction exports, records dynamic tool assembly as an agent-level warning with a concrete resolver, and invents no tool binding. Runner-owned validation passed, and workspace-patch evidence shows only moldea/moldea.yaml changed.

requirements.evidence: moldea/moldea.yaml binds runtimeAgent to /src/support-assistant.ts#SupportAssistant and instructionLoader to /src/support-assistant.ts#loadSupportInstruction. src/support-assistant.ts exports both symbols and SupportAssistant.getSystemPrompt() calls the loader. The bounded src inventory contains only support-assistant.ts and dynamic-tools.ts, so removed source was not recreated. Deterministic-after reports valid inspect/validate and passing typecheck; workspace-patch evidence identifies only moldea/moldea.yaml as changed.

The support agent's unresolved.dynamic-tool-registry-wiring entry has effect warning, explains that static inspection cannot prove the final relationship, resolves through closed runtime wiring or an integration test proving entries exposed to SupportAssistant, and relates /src/dynamic-tools.ts#assembleTools. No tools binding is present. src/dynamic-tools.ts dynamically merges runtime-selected ToolSet maps, remained hash-identical before and after, and workspace-patch evidence shows only moldea/moldea.yaml changed.
